operators.name: instance_norm_forward
semantics: Computes instance normalization over spatial dims (H, W) for each sample and channel independently, without affine parameters.
mean = mean(x[n,c,:,:]), var = var(x[n,c,:,:], unbiased=False); output = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
Input tensor is expected to be contiguous CUDA float32; output has same shape, dtype, and device.
No running statistics are tracked; affine=False as in reference.

operators.name: add_scalar
semantics: Adds a scalar broadcast to every element of the input tensor.
output = x + scalar; same shape, dtype, and device.
